shortDesc.message: Use Copy Text from Image to seamlessly extract text from picture and convert image to text with accurate online OCR in seconds.

storeDesc.message:
Need to copy text from image but don’t want to retype it manually? Our powerful Chrome extension lets you instantly extract it from any selected area on a webpage — including video, screenshots, scanned documents, and even PDFs (just open them in your browser first). Whether you're a student, researcher, or professional, this tool will boost your productivity like never before.

✨ Key Benefits of Using Our Extension to Copy Text from Images
➤ One-click text copy from image right inside your browser
➤ Supports JPG, PNG, PDF (when opened in browser)
➤ Fast and accurate online OCR recognition
➤ Works with screenshots, scanned pages, and web graphics
➤ Smart clipboard support for quick pasting

📌 Why This Copy Text from Image Extension Stands Out
1. No more manual typing — select, scan, done
2. Online OCR reader online for real-time access
3. Compatible with most modern websites
4. Extract from infographics, documents, tables
5. Supports multiple fonts and styles

🖼️ Works with All Popular Formats
This extension isn't limited to just static web content. You can extract text from image and also from:
● Scanned PDFs (just open them in Chrome)
● Screenshots uploaded to the browser
● PNGs and JPEGs embedded in websites
● Document previews and charts
● Any file viewable in a browser tab

📋 How Using the Extension
1️⃣ Install the copy text from image extension
2️⃣ Select the area of the info you want to read
3️⃣ Wait a moment while the OCR engine processes it
4️⃣ Your extraction is ready to copy and paste!
5️⃣ Use it anywhere: Word, Notion, Google Docs

💡 Popular Use Cases
- Students taking notes from scanned textbooks
- Developers extracting code snippets from tutorials
- Designers copying font samples from mockups
- Marketers grabbing content from infographics
- Writers transcribing words from images for research

🔍 Advanced Capabilities with Smart Recognition
🔶 Image to text converter for complex layouts
🔶 OCR character recognition online for multiple languages
🔶 Pic to word and pic to text output support
🔶 Table, list, and paragraph detection
🔶 Copy text from image even if rotated

📑 Supported Actions
✔️ From copying text from image to converting full pic to word
✔️ Copy all text from image with one click
✔️ Extract text from picture regions with high precision
✔️ Image text extractor even works on stylized fonts
✔️ Copy image text from PDF after viewing in browser

🌐 Online-Only, Real-Time Accuracy
Because the extension works online, you get instant access to the most advanced OCR text recognition models — no need to download anything. Just highlight the content area, and the result appears within seconds. Seamless and effortless.

📈 Ideal for Anyone Who Needs to Copy Text from Image:
♦️ Researchers using jpg to word tools
♦️ Students converting notes using text copier from image
♦️ Professionals extract info from business cards
♦️ Content creators using converter for visuals
♦️ Teams that need quick copy paste text from image for reporting

⚙️ Features You’ll Love:

❇️ Simple UI with drag-to-select functionality
❇️ Online OCR means it’s always up to date
❇️ Extension to copy text from image with minimal clicks

🧠 Learn How to Copy Text from Image — Fast
Don’t know how to copy text from an image or screenshot? This tool makes it as simple as dragging your cursor. And the results are nearly instant with OCR character recognition online tool.

📊 Extra Features:
⬆️ Copy paste text from image extension integrated into Chrome

🛠 Multiple Tools in One
▶️ Copy text from image online with high accuracy

Add the copy and paste text from image extension to Chrome and start transforming your workflow. No more typing from picture. Just select, extract, and paste — instantly
